record.body:
## Rationale

R27 asks that the existing deep-link and overlay tests pass unchanged. One test in `src/lib/screens/dialogs.test.ts` mounts the app at the empty hash and expects the effort Home. R1 makes the empty hash the product index, so the test cannot pass at `#/`. The test checks focus return after Escape on the needs dialog, which has nothing to do with the landing page. Mounting it at `#/effort/dashboard` keeps every assertion and tests the same behavior. `deepLinks.test.ts`, `detail.test.ts` and `detailNav.test.ts` stay byte-identical, and a diff check enforces that. `dialogs.test.ts` is checked by running it, with the one-line mount change allowed.

## Counter-argument

A fallback that renders the effort Home at `#/` when the store has no areas would keep the test unchanged. It also splits the landing page into two behaviors, which `landing-product-index` rejected, and it hides the product index on a store that has not been backfilled.

payload.alternatives: Zero-areas fallback that renders the effort Home at #/
payload.choice: Mount the focus-return dialogs test at #/effort/dashboard; keep its assertions
